text:
sarah: Hey team — bringing up xenon13b (int8) on dedicated pool, seeing intermittent OOMs during the first ~150 tokens for some requests. Canary launched with batch_size=8, max_new_tokens=512, kv_prefetch=true. Logs attached below. Anyone seen early-step OOMs like this?

vikram: Can you paste the serving config and a short snippet of the error? often fragmentation hits on int8 with our prefetch pattern.

sarah: config:```json
{
  "model": "xenon13b-int8",
  "batch_size": 8,
  "max_new_tokens": 512,
  "kv_prefetch": true,
  "quant": "int8"
}
```
error log:```
E tensorflow: cuda out of memory at step 134 | alloc 1.2GB | free 0.5GB
Trace: gpu_alloc()->alloc_big_block()->OOM
```

jaime: Looks like classic KV arena fragmentation + large max_new_tokens. Two quick levers: lower batch_size and reduce max_new_tokens. Also try kv_prefetch=false for canary.

toni: +1. Also enable "kv_eviction_threshold" to 0.6 so the runtime will trim older prefixes when memory pressure spikes. It helped with a similar int8 bring-up.

vikram: Another thing — warmup pattern matters. Cold-start requests with long prefix can trigger fragmentation. Try a slowstart rollout (start with batch 2, max_new_tokens 128, ramp over 30m).

sarah: ok i'll flip to batch_size=4, max_new_tokens=256, kv_prefetch=false and set kv_eviction_threshold=0.6. Will run a 50-instance canary for 1h.

ci-bot: canary deployment started by sarah — xenon13b-int8/canary-2026-03-20-10:15Z. 50 instances.

jaime: also capture per-device memory stats: run the debug hook:```bash
redwood-debug mem-sample --interval 2s --devices all --output /tmp/xenon-mem.json
```
that file helps correlate OOMs with allocation spikes.

toni: if OOMs persist after the above, try switching to async alloc (cudaMallocAsync) or reduce the model kv cache size through our quant profile: set quant_profile.padding_factor=0.9 for lower arena slack.

vikram: final note — monitor latency regressions. lowering max_new_tokens reduces tail cost but might affect quality for some prompt classes. We'll run a short eval set to compare perplexity and answer completeness after the canary.

sarah: sounds good. i'll post canary results + mem dump in this thread in ~1h. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
